Zero Foods Indonesia

Healthy Sweetness. No Bitter Finish.

ZERO makes healthy living easier with zero-calorie sweetness that tastes smooth in coffee and drinks instead of leaving the bitter aftertaste people expect from sugar-free products.

Zero-calorie syrup, drops, topping, and wellness products built for daily use.

Core Products

Three Formats. One Daily Routine.

ZERO is organized by how people actually use it: syrup for home drinks, drops for carry-anywhere sweetness, and topping for richer pours.

ZERO Syrup

Daily sweetness without the bitter finish.

ZERO Syrup comes in 50ml, 250ml, and 550ml bottles, with 16 flavors ranging from coffee classics to fruit and refreshment profiles.

From Rp10K to Rp69K
ZERO Drops

Portable sweetness in 5 to 7 drops.

The dropper format is built for pockets, bags, and day-to-day convenience, with 5ml, 10ml, and 30ml options across the lineup.

Rp20K to Rp49K
Maple Topping

A richer topping format for heavier pours.

Maple Topping gives ZERO a thicker, dessert-friendly format that can sit alongside syrups and drops without feeling like the same product again.

Built for stacks, drizzles, and dense drinks

Why ZERO

Built for Better Daily Habits.

ZERO gives customers a few clear ways to use the brand: sweeten drinks at home, carry sweetness anywhere, and add functional products to daily routines.

Better-tasting sweetness

ZERO Syrup is positioned as a smoother alternative to the bitter aftertaste many customers associate with stevia-based products.

Portable convenience

ZERO Drops sweeten a drink with just 5 to 7 drops, giving customers a format that can travel anywhere.

Functional support

ZFIT expands beyond sweetness with prebiotic fiber syrup and ACVS for customers focused on overall wellness.

Local mission

The company mission is simple: make Indonesia healthier by making healthy choices easier.

Product Lines

Three Formats. One Shared Goal.

Each line solves a different job, so customers can pick the format that fits the moment instead of adapting to one product.

ZERO Syrup

Zero-calorie syrup in 16 flavors and three bottle sizes for home drinks, cafes, and repeat daily use.

ZERO Drops

Concentrated liquid sweetness in a glass dropper for customers who want the most portable format in the lineup.

ZFIT

A branch-off mission focused on functional products like Fiber Syrup and ACVS, with more innovations planned through 2026.

Company Info

Built by a Focused Team.

ZERO Foods Indonesia was founded in 2024 and runs from Yogyakarta with a team focused on product development, public health, and day-to-day operations.

01. Founders

Brent Vincent and Giri Gusman founded ZERO, with Branch Vincent leading much of the brand and marketing execution.

02. Address

ZERO is based at Jl. Jombor Tegal No.124 A, Jombor Lor, Sinduadi, Kec. Mlati, Kabupaten Sleman, DI Yogyakarta 55284.

03. Contact

Customers can reach the brand through WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube under the zerofoods.id identity.
